name: RuleEngine::audit_diff

test_list.description: An AST pattern matching changed code yields a finding.
A matching construct outside changed byte hunks yields no finding.
Findings include mapped metadata and a digest of the snippet, never its raw contents.
Missing grammar or rule coverage is explicit.
An AST-shaped joined path with an explicit parent component reports CWE-22; a benign joined path does not.
Repeated deallocation of the same AST expression is a disputed potential CWE-415 indicator; reassignment is a negative case.
Repeated C++ delete of the same AST expression is a disputed potential CWE-415 indicator.
A free followed by same-expression pointer dereference in one C++ block is a disputed potential CWE-416 indicator; no lifetime proof is claimed.
A pointer reassignment between free and dereference does not match the finite same-expression UAF pattern.
Dereferencing a different expression after free is a negative case for this pattern.
A same-path symlink metadata check followed by open is a disputed CWE-59 race indicator.
Direct CUDA thread-local indexing is an informational review hint with no CWE; a safe explicit bounds guard is also recorded as a known false positive.

inputs.name: request
inputs.description: Validated relative path, old/new source and bounded changed byte spans.

output_description: Findings restricted to changed hunks plus explicit language coverage.
